from pathlib import Path
import csv,json,hashlib,subprocess
root=Path.cwd();p=root/'udt_machian_global_clock_feasibility_2026-09-28'
def git(*a):return subprocess.check_output(['git','-c','core.preloadIndex=false','-c','index.threads=1','-c','core.packedGitWindowSize=8m','-c','core.packedGitLimit=32m',*a])
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
docs={'LIVE.md','HANDOFF.md','CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md','MEMORY.md','INDEX.md','UDT_RESEARCH_ROADMAP.md'}
payload={str(f.relative_to(root)) for f in p.rglob('*') if f.is_file()}
staged=set(git('diff','--cached','--name-only').decode().splitlines())
assert staged==payload|docs,sorted(staged.symmetric_difference(payload|docs))
assert not git('diff','--name-only').strip()
for name in staged:assert git('show',':'+name)==(root/name).read_bytes(),name
with (p/'SHA256_MANIFEST.tsv').open() as f:
 rows=list(csv.DictReader(f,delimiter='\t'))
for row in rows:
 b=(p/row['path']).read_bytes();assert sha(b)==row['sha256'] and len(b)==int(row['bytes']),row['path']
assert {row['path'] for row in rows}|{'SHA256_MANIFEST.tsv'}=={str(f.relative_to(p)) for f in p.rglob('*') if f.is_file()}
for name,h in json.loads((p/'review/FINAL_FIDELITY_SEAL.json').read_text())['sha256'].items():assert sha(git('show',':'+name))==h,name
launch=json.loads((p/'LAUNCH.json').read_text())
prior=git('ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard').decode().splitlines()
assert sorted(prior)==sorted(launch['prior_untracked_paths'])
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').strip()==git('rev-parse','origin/grok').strip()==launch['head'].encode()
git('diff','--cached','--check')
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','staged_files':len(staged),'package_files':len(payload),'maintained_pointers':len(docs),'manifest_payloads':len(rows),'every_staged_blob_matches_disk':True,'all_final_fidelity_pins_match_staged_bytes':True,'prior_untracked_names_preserved':len(prior),'tracked_unstaged_changes':False,'commit_push':'pending'},indent=2))
